_what: The model relay of computer/model-relay.mjs: an AI harness running inside a place of its own (a virtual machine) reaches a model provider through this Mac, and the person's provider credential never enters the place. The relay listens only on this Mac's address on the place's own private network (the interface whose subnet holds the place's address), on `port`, and answers only peers inside that subnet that present a live token of the place at that peer's address. Each provider is a row of `providers`: `prefix` is the path the guest calls, `upstream` where it is forwarded, `token_headers` the headers the guest's own tool sends its key in (the place token stands in that key; `Bearer ` is taken off), `credential_header` and `credential_format` how the person's credential is put on the forwarded call, `usage` the answer fields (alternatives split by |) that say the model and the tokens used, read from a JSON answer or each `data:` line of a stream, and `guest_env` the variables a harness in the place is given ({relay} this relay's address for the place, {token} the place token). The person names each provider's credential as a secret reference (secret://provider/path, computer/secret-references.json) in their own `credentials_file` under `credentials`; it is read at the moment of each call and is never kept, logged, put in a program's arguments or answered. A new provider is one more row.

words.no_network: This Mac has no address on the network of {address}, so the model relay cannot listen for it.
words.not_in_subnet: Only a place on this Mac's own private network may call the model relay.
words.no_token: This call carries no live token of a place at its address: a token ends when its place stops, is removed, or its time is up.
words.no_credential: No credential for {provider} is set: name a secret reference for it under credentials.{provider} in {file}.
words.credential_failed: The credential for {provider} could not be read, so nothing was sent.
words.too_big: A call to the model relay is at most {most} bytes.
words.upstream_failed: {provider} could not be reached through the relay.
